description: Training-only packages added on top of any base profile. Loaded by PinResolver via required_for(env_id, extras=['training']) and used by EnvRepairer when the user enters the Train tab or clicks Fix Issues. Versions intentionally permissive — the training stack moves fast and the resolver picks the latest compatible build.
notes: triton-windows is the Windows-only counterpart to mainline triton (which only ships Linux/macOS wheels). On Linux, omit it from the install list.
Empty spec means 'pip resolves the latest compatible version'. Pin tightly only when a specific version is required for compatibility.
